unresolved_identities: den Grafen (§11) is a regest-local FunctionalActor; the Landfrieden names no individual count.
Bauern, Kaufleute, Ritter and alle zu Pferde Reisenden are regest-local E74 groups for social categories, not communities with register entries.
model_gaps: No role for the persons or categories a norm applies to (norm addressee); Bauern, Kaufleute and Ritter in the arms provision are rv:Participant.
The mixed prohibition and permission of arms bearing (Verbot bzw. Erlaubnis) cannot be split per category without paraphrase, so §12, 13 and 15 stay one enactment.
Most Landfrieden provisions name penalties or procedures whose content the regest only summarises (Strafen, Maßnahmen, Verfahren); the factoids hold the wording but no structured penalty or offence.
The price-setting competence of the count (§11) has no fitting right type; no rf:concerns was recorded for it.
The Heribert drafting note is a chancery note and was skipped.

unresolved_identities: 'vom König' is identified with the packet's shared ruler (Friedrich Barbarossa); the regest does not name him in this passage.
model_gaps: The royal investiture of Wichmann is reported in the pope's indirect speech ('worden sei'); the model has no way to mark a factoid as a party's assertion within the source, so it stands as an ordinary Appointment factoid.
No act type for a command or threat of sanction; both are recorded as rv:Enactment.
The Magdeburg see and 'Amt und Pfründe' are modelled as E30 rights of type rv:ChurchRights; whether an episcopal see is a right is an expert question.

unresolved_identities: Eberhard von Salzburg, Hartwig von Bremen and Hillin von Trier have no matching register candidate in this packet and are regest-local actors.

model_gaps: No role for the author or sender of a letter; Papst Eugen (III.) and the senders of Reg. 103 are rv:Participant in the communication factoids.
No act type for a refusal of consent; the pope's declaration that he will never consent to Wichmann's translation is an rv:Enactment partOf the letter, with 'niemals' as qualifier.
The pope's disapproval of the bishops' intervention ('maßlos erstaunt', 'nicht billigen könne') has no fitting act type and is covered only as evidence of the earlier letter's subject.
